completeness.listVsSingleGet: verified identical — list payloads are not truncated
completeness.rawVersionHistory: 11.9 MB, not committed; history-index.json summarises it and it is reproducible with GET /assistant/{id}/version?limit=100
completeness.toolVersionHistory: not available: GET /tool/{id}/version returns 404 for all 20 tools

npcSplit.note: Vapi has no folder concept; the split is by name prefix and corroborated by squad membership and phone-number naming. Only the NPC set is in scope for migration — see ../npc-services/clone-plan.json.

source.method: GET only — nothing in this org was modified to produce it

assistantDeepCapture.prompts: prompts/<sha16>.md — every distinct system-prompt block across current state AND all version history, stored once, as readable text.
assistantDeepCapture.history: history/<assistant>.json — every version's full configuration, verbatim, with system prompts replaced by promptRef into the store.
assistantDeepCapture.lossless: Verified: all 444 versions rehydrate to a byte-identical match against the raw API payload, and every live prompt block is present unaltered.
assistantDeepCapture.state: state/<assistant>.md — one readable card per assistant covering model, voice, transcriber, server, tools, messages, behaviour flags, prompt refs and call counts.
assistantDeepCapture.comparison: COMPARISON.md — the 15 NPC assistants side by side, plus a tool matrix.
assistantDeepCapture.callVolume: call-volume.json — COUNTS ONLY. No transcript, recording, phone number or any other call content was requested or stored.
